title: Cost-derived visual frost states for heat-pump defrost timing

00_intake.label: Intake and plan
00_intake.gate: Research question, data scope, deliverables and claim boundaries are explicit.

01_sources.label: Source ingestion
01_sources.gate: Every source used downstream has a stable source ID, DOI or local author-data anchor, and a stated read/verification status.
01_sources.notes: Direct optimal-timing, frost-tracking, image-control and grouped-validation precedents are indexed; full-text audits still gate detailed comparative claims.

02_research.label: Research question and evidence
02_research.gate: Every central planned claim is mapped to author data or verified literature and unsupported causal or priority claims are blocked.
02_research.notes: Evidence matrix and claim register distinguish supported cost results, provisional RGB results, contradicted novelty claims and unsupported deployment claims.

03_spine.label: Motivation spine
03_spine.gate: One controlling motivation connects the operational decision gap, cost-regret labels, RGB validation and explicit claim boundaries.
03_spine.notes: Confirmed motivation: an auditable cost-regret-to-image bridge with experiment-held-out and time-only controls.
